name: media-analysis
description: Transcript-based analysis of recorded meetings, talks and discussions: Q&A, decision extraction and summarization with [mm:ss] timestamp citations.
when_to_use: Use for questions over a supplied transcript: what participants said about a topic, which decisions were made, meeting summaries, action items and quote lookup with timestamp citations.
